purpose: error location/type -> effect estimates -> decisions -> analytic and stored independent do outcomes; not favoring a metric
scope: existing20 development references, no new reference structures or discovery algorithms, no manufacturing rollout

A.reuse: all positive primary controlled rows in old S1/S7 and C01..C12; no new graph selection
A.matching: same dataset/task/policy; exact counts and skeleton/strict-directed F1 equality within1e-12; record ineligible pairs
A.outcome: analytic loss and stored do mean loss separately, improvement=reference-loss, regret=loss-best
A.large_deterioration: recommended loss-reference loss > 1.0 * original loss_scale^2, fixed before new diagnostic output; descriptive design threshold not physical safety

B.discovery_scope: all primary confirmed_only720 operational cells, three policies separately for cases
B.fixed_effect: mean do(.5)-mean do(0), independent of optimized action
B.case_rules: predefined all high skeleton>=.9 with fixed effect error>.25; all low skeleton<=.7 with error<=.1; export all qualifying and large-loss cases
B.limited_refits: C07 all6 existing datasets: fit unmodified true-structure model with alpha from corresponding old BOSS primary; existing flawed BOSS models unchanged; artificial oracle diagnostic, not discovered graphs
B.coefficient_controls: C07 BOSS counterfactual predictor: replace only slope with true total slope keeping original intercept, and replace only intercept with true0 keeping slope; diagnostic perfect-knowledge controls, not deployable recommenders

C.policy: confirmed_only operational outcome, original task loss_scale^2, analytic regret primary
C.models: BASE; SIMPLE; SIMPLE+each of7 nonempty quality subsets =9 fixed candidates
C.prediction_constraint: max(0, prediction), inherited prespecified nonnegative outcome constraint
C.validation: whole-structure outer LOSO; all transformation fit train only; nested whole-structure inner CV for candidate selection; simplest candidate within .01 MAE of inner best, fixed order tie-break
C.selection_role: development only; no independent confirmation claim

D.planning: paired structure SD, 95% halfwidth .005 and .01 unchanged meaningful increment benchmark; show .01 halfwidth sensitivity separately, no retroactive threshold change
D.questions: small nonzero predictive information != meaningful decision improvement; largerN does not increase mean improvement
D.gate: only run fresh independent cohort if model stability, precision, budget all met; otherwise no new cohort
D.extremes: keep C07; report full outcome and separate large-loss stratum, no winsorization/deletion

manufacturing: existing state/evidence only; no repeat Slack/raw search or new simulator runs
